local_review.finding_body:
Workflow run 36703838247 on head 6c0fa721e6586c33399a7b89ed229c10fbf3bd74 failed all three matrix jobs in Disable docker networking. Each job ran sudo apt-get install openbsd-inetd without first refreshing apt indexes, requested libevent-2.1-7t64_2.1.12-stable-9ubuntu2.1, and received 404 Not Found before checkMetadataFiles or the coordinate test task ran. Runs for unrelated contributions failed at the same shared step, and merged PR #10274 repaired .github/workflows/scripts/disable-docker.sh by running apt-get update first. This is outside the contribution's closed file set, so FS-contribution-contract.5.2 and .5.3 prohibit repairing it in this PR and require human intervention.

Infrastructure issue: https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/issues/10277 (#10277)
local_review.finding_title: Metadata CI used a stale apt index when installing openbsd-inetd
local_review.fix_note: No contribution files were changed. Reviewed the full contribution shape and tests, then verified ./gradlew pullAllowedDockerImages checkMetadataFiles test -Pcoordinates=io.micronaut.reactor:micronaut-reactor:4.0.0 --stacktrace and GVM_TCK_NATIVE_IMAGE_MODE=future-defaults-all ./gradlew test -Pcoordinates=io.micronaut.reactor:micronaut-reactor:4.0.0 --stacktrace; both passed locally.
local_review.review_comment: All three metadata-test matrix jobs in workflow run 36703838247 failed in the shared Disable docker networking step before metadata validation or library tests ran. The runner's stale apt index requested libevent-2.1-7t64_2.1.12-stable-9ubuntu2.1, which the Ubuntu mirrors returned as 404; the same failure affected multiple unrelated PRs and was fixed in shared script PR #10274. The contribution diff itself remains scoped to io.micronaut.reactor:micronaut-reactor:4.0.0 and passed local metadata checks and both current-defaults and future-defaults-all test lanes. Because the CI failure can only be repaired in shared workflow infrastructure, FS-contribution-contract.5.2 and .5.3 require escalation rather than a contribution edit.
